_doc: Which signal column feeds which per-subject statistics accumulator, plus accumulator hyperparameters. Per redesign-2026-05 §3: cross-lens information must not combine inside an accumulator's update(); only the *Selector* stage may combine across lenses. Each statistics block stands on its own.

signal_statistics._doc: Per-subject Welford μ/Σ + dynamic-K PCA over the unified signal vector. Includes both MediaPipe and 6DRepNet head-pose columns so downstream selectors can compare/blend the two estimators (cross-signal interaction permitted only at the selector stage). Note: NaN in any column triggers full-frame skip — a side-angle frame where MediaPipe returns no mesh leaves mediapipe__* NaN, so that frame is not accumulated. Resolving this without breaking cov-matrix semantics is a task #26 decision (split accumulator vs NaN-aware Welford).

appearance_statistics._doc: Eigenface bank (mean_face + top-K eigen_faces). Frontal-only. Per the spec decision: MediaPipe is the authoritative source for the *appearance / shape standard* — its 468pt mesh is the most precise on frontal faces, and the mesh failing on side angles works as a natural admission gate (no signal → no contribution). Admission threshold is on mediapipe__frontality; head_pose__frontality is *not* used here (6DRepNet keeps running on side angles, defeating the purpose). Placeholder for visualbind/statistics/appearance.py.

shape_statistics._doc: Eigen face-landmark (ASM-style). Frontal-only, MediaPipe-sourced (mediapipe__frontality admission, signal/face__landmarks for the mesh). Placeholder for visualbind/statistics/shape.py.

category_statistics._doc: Per-attribute vote counting (hair / accessory / etc.). Frontal-gated for static attributes. No columns wired yet — needs a face-attribute plugin upstream.
